items.title: Litigation funding in English-seated commercial arbitration
items.description: Third-party litigation funding – whereby an independent funder pays some or all of a party's costs in connection with legal proceedings in exchange for a financial return should the case succeed – is has become an established feature of commercial arbitration seated in England & Wales. In this article, we explore the use of litigation funding in English-seated commercial arbitration, including its interaction with institutional rules, potential pitfalls and practical guidance to ensure its effective use.
